component.name: NeoAmp
component.summary: Play music and internet radio with classic Winamp skins

description.p: NeoAmp is a music player with a pixel-exact reproduction of the classic Winamp 2.x interface: the main window, the equalizer and the playlist editor, drawn with classic Winamp skins (.wsz files).

ul.li: Plays MP3, MP2, AAC, M4A (AAC and Apple Lossless), WAV, AIFF, FLAC and Ogg Vorbis files without gaps between tracks
Plays SHOUTcast and Icecast internet radio
Ten-band equalizer with Winamp's presets, spectrum analyzer and oscilloscope
MilkDrop, the visualizer Winamp came with, with 98 presets built in and a folder for your own
M3U and PLS playlists, Jump to file and File info
Windows that dock and snap together, and fold down to windowshade bars
Media keys and the desktop's "now playing" controls
Opens music, playlists and skins from the file manager, in the NeoAmp that's already open

description.p: NeoAmp is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the makers of Winamp.
